critic_unverified.expected: These are the standard ways clinicians write age and sex. '58M'/'58F', 'y/o M/F', 'Gender: M/F' and 'Male, 58' should be read. Because they are not, any later 'N years old' on another line silently becomes the age (see the age-phrase finding).
critic_unverified.detail: _SEX_RES knows only male|man|gentleman / female|woman|lady and 'sex: m|f'.
